rv.q: We’re left with a life-affirming feel-good musical, giving hope that love always wins.
With a magnificent story, cast, staging, and staging this show deserves to be the next big musical hit.
Becoming Nancy is a delightful, joyful, refreshing piece of new musical theatre with so much potential.
Like its protagonist, David, it just hasn’t discovered who it is fully as yet.
In conclusion, Becoming Nancy feels like a “paint by numbers” musical, hitting familiar beats without adding anything new to the genre.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this UK premiere, with some calling it a blockbuster and praising Jerry Mitchell's direction, while others find it falls short of its elite creative team's potential.

vr.q: I loved this show. I would go and see it again if I could. I encourage everyone to get a ticket.
